summary.text: Russell Goodwin is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 12, where he took office on January 6, 2025, and he is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small business owner and volunteer pastor who previously served on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors.

paragraphs.text: Russell Goodwin earned a high school diploma from Shorewood High School and attended the University of Memphis, the Milwaukee Area Technical College and Oral Roberts University.

His career experience includes owning Goodwin Enterprises, LLC, and working as a youth pastor, published author, actor, singer and musician; he has served as a volunteer pastor at The Movement Center Church and as a member of the Council on Highway Safety.
Goodwin represented District 18 on the Milwaukee County Board of Supervisors from 2020 to 2022.
He joined the Assembly in January 2025 and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Jobs and the Economy and Urban Revitalization committees.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in a union household, owns a small business and serves as a volunteer pastor, and he listed public safety, schools, lower property taxes, support for working families and economic opportunity as his priorities.
